chunks: And lots were cast, and he was among those who were thrown overboard.

key_terms.الْمُدْحَضِينَ: The ones thrown overboard / The rejected

ai.seo_question: Who was thrown into the sea during the storm according to the narration of Prophet Yunus?
ai.summary: This narration highlights the casting of lots (qur'ah) to identify Prophet Yunus (Jonah) among the crew during the storm, a method used to determine divine selection. In Shia scholarly tradition, this event underscores the theme of voluntary submission to Allah's decree, as Yunus accepted his fate after initially leaving his post. The phrase 'among the thrown' signifies his subsequent casting into the sea, marking the beginning of his trial and eventual deliverance.
